reviews.title: Fantastic & hypoallergenic!
reviews.body: These are fantastic. I have super sensitive skin and am allergic to nickel and these are the only razors heads that do not irritate my skin. I went my whole life thinking that there was no way for me avoid irritation, bumps, etc. after shaving, but apparently I just needed the right razor. I cannot recommend these enough.

reviews.title: Excellent blades
reviews.body: I love these as they stay sharp for a very long time and they are great value for the money.  Shaving closeness is sublime, and sometimes I don't have to shave for a couple of days, perhaps three! It's easy to switch with the little button on the top and one  just clickss the new razor into place.  You can hear a soft click to ensure it's tightly in place.  I rarely cut myself while using these, the glide is crazy good, even without a lot of lather.  Razor burn has never been an issue.  The blade quantity is the best I have found for the price.  The fit inside the handle is especially good, too, as I rarely have had the razor come out of its snug spot while shaving.  I have used these for many years.  They are quite safe.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 18 May 2026
reviews.author: M. Gift

features: EXCEPTIONAL QUALITY: Premium quality blade refills for the award-winning Billie razor. The blades are designed with optimal spacing between each blade to allow shave cream, soap and hair to pass on by. Each 5-blade cartridge works with any of the Billie women’s razor handles.

COMFORTABLE SHAVE: Made with nickel-free blades and soothing aloe shave soap, the Billie women’s 5-blade razor refill provides a smooth glide and a comfortable shave that feels like butter and floats like magic.
DERMATOLOGIST-APPROVED: The Billie razor and refill blades are safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Say bye to stubble, irritation, bumps and ingrowns! Say hello to smoooooooth skin.

LONG-LASTING: Each Billie razor refill pack includes 4 refill blades to ensure you are stocked up on smooooooth and never run out of fresh shaves! For optimal smoothness, don’t forget to store your Billie razor on the magnetic holder to keep your blades safe and dry between shaves.

COMPLETE SHAVE EXPERIENCE: Get the most out of your shave and pair your Billie women’s razor with the Billie Whipped Shave Cream for the ultimate shave experience. It’s 100% non-aerosol and made with super gentle ingredients to help your fresh blades give you a close shave.
